task_title: Issue #1 fresh-install solver chain: wrapper + seed + robustness + docs
task_criteria: scripts/pi-agent ships a reference wrapper implementing the pi-agent solve CLI contract (--problem-file/--output/--evidence/--signatures/--model/--api-key), with PI_HOME-first install discovery, provider-qualified model mapping (openrouter fallback when only OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set), and closed stdin (stdio ignore) so pi never hangs on non-TTY stdin
`off-by-one seed` loads the bundled flat corpus (data/answers/*.json) into SQLite idempotently (re-run creates zero duplicates) so fresh installs can discover bundled classes immediately

extraReadOnlyPaths mounts /tmp/pi only when present; OB1_BWRAP_TIMEOUT env (seconds, default 300) tunes the bwrap cap with invalid values falling back to the default; API key selection falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is empty/placeholder

README documents the full solver chain (bwrap prerequisite, real pi link earendil-works/pi, wrapper install, model config, solve-time expectations, OB1_BWRAP_TIMEOUT), and the seed step in the quick start
Full gate battery passes: go build, go vet, gofmt clean, go test ./... -short (13 pkgs ok), gitreins guard 4/4
